title: Validate demand for a paid AI/AWS engineering micro-offer
hypothesis: A narrowly scoped, fixed-price offer (e.g. a paid AWS/AI architecture quick-review or similar productized service) tied to the human owner's existing AI/AWS/DevOps consulting expertise generates paid interest when boosted with a small paid test, validating a growth vector that does not compete for the BRL 100 single-position capital ceiling that caps market-based strategies at current equity.
success_metric: At least 1 paid conversion OR at least 5 qualified inbound leads (explicit interest, reply, or booking) within 14 days of launch.
kill_condition: Fewer than 2 qualified signals within 14 days despite the test budget being fully spent.

revisions.change: Removed dependency on the blog as the landing destination: human owner confirmed the blog is not yet ready and cannot serve as a lead-capture channel right now. Original hypothesis referenced 'organic traffic' and 'blog positioning' as the baseline; both assumed a working blog funnel.
revisions.revised_plan: Point the small paid test at a minimal, standalone offer page (not the blog) -- e.g. a single Carrd/Notion/one-pager page or a direct booking link (Calendly-style) describing one fixed-price service, plus a short paid post/ad on a channel with existing professional reach (e.g. LinkedIn). This keeps the experiment capital-light and fast to launch without depending on the blog's completion, and still tests the real question: does the underlying offer generate paid interest, independent of which page hosts it.
revisions.still_open: Exact page tool and ad channel not yet chosen -- this is an execution detail for whoever builds the experiment, not a strategic decision requiring further capital-allocation analysis.
